report.scene: A white MY ONLY STYLER hot air brush with black bristles lies on a gray wood floor with its black power cord looped around it, and the cord appears cut with two loose ends near the top center.

matching_details: White body with black bristle brush head in the lower center of the photo
"MY ONLY STYLER" printed in black on the handle near the center right
Control buttons and slider on the handle, right of the printed name
Perforated silver air vent at the right end of the handle
Black power cord with strain relief at the right end and a two-prong plug at the top center
Long, narrow shape that fits the 12 by 1.75 inch description
product.reason_plain: Yes, this looks like the recalled MyOnlyStyler dryer, but the photo is the same as the official recall picture.
product.reason_technical: Brand text, white body with black bristles, button layout, vent and cord all match the official image. The model number MOS-22 on the back of the handle is not visible. The owner's photo appears pixel for pixel identical to the official CPSC image, including the cord layout, velcro tie and floor grain.

actions.evidence: The cord appears cut through, with a cut end showing exposed wire near the top center and a second loose end near the velcro tie on the upper left. However, this image is identical to the official CPSC recall image, so it may not show the owner's own dryer.

identifiers.where: The back of the handle, where the model number is printed, is not shown. Small printed text on the cord is not readable.

photo_source.reason: The image looks like a real camera photo, but it is identical to the official CPSC recall image in every detail, including cord placement, the velcro tie, lighting and floor grain, so it was likely downloaded rather than taken by the owner.

report.retake_tip: Please take your own new photo of your dryer with the cut cord, and turn the handle so the model number on the back shows.
